compositionBoundary: Consumes the signed provider receipt and post-materialization executable assay from the independent semantic-candidate-review service. The provider process must differ from the candidate author and bind the exact CandidatePatchK and RequirementSetK.
receipt: VerificationOutcomeK preserves provider receipt, review subject, real endpoint, fresh-process digest, timestamps, exact candidate and requirements, executable command, artifact digests, outcome, and economics.
refusal: Refuse self-review, same-process or pre-materialization runs, wrong candidate/requirements, missing signed-provider receipt, non-interface endpoints, empty assay artifacts, provider authority, or malformed timestamps.
acceptance: Passed verification is never customer acceptance or demand closure. Only urn:leader:emsenn may issue the separate CustomerOutcomeK.
